unit.why: A single anecdote: as boys, the future Mogielnica rebbe outshone the future gaon in a Torah test set by his grandfather, then tearfully begged forgiveness for the shame caused. The anecdote is given in two transmissions.

stories.start_quote: כב שמעתי ממנו ז"ל כי פ"א
stories.end_quote: עד שאמרתי לו כי אמחול לו
stories.summary_en: The grandfather of the Mogielnica rebbe showed a Torah matter to the young future gaon, who did not grasp the novelty; he then called his grandson, who grasped it at once, so the other boy was shamed; afterwards the grandson ran after him weeping and begged forgiveness until it was granted.

ומיד הרגשתי ואמרתי אליו זה וזה יש להתחדש
